assumptions.assumption: Selecting installed native libraries permits read-only metadata for confined DLL basenames without granting arbitrary host filesystem access.
assumptions.basis: NativeRuntime.dll_paths validates a basename and canonical containment. WindowsConfig.embedded disables general host_filesystem access. The installed whoami execution requests VERSION.dll metadata.
assumptions.dependent-result: Selected-runtime resolution and the continued denial of unrelated mapped paths.
assumptions.stress-test: Selected and missing DLLs; traversal and link escapes; host_filesystem=false; WoW64 System32 selection.
assumptions.falsification-probe: Any unselected path succeeds solely because native_libraries=true, or a selected path escapes its canonical runtime directory.
assumptions.scope: Exercised configured selections; concurrent external namespace mutation has no new atomicity guarantee.

assumptions.assumption: All four producer ABI views execute on the same Windows build29683 ARM64 kernel.
assumptions.basis: Read-only RtlGetVersion capture, ARM64 Python process, bound source/PE/six-DLL observations from native producer v10.
assumptions.dependent-result: Measured ABI capture, serialization and error-order profile; no independent physical x64-kernel claim.
assumptions.stress-test: Native/WoW64 alignment, malformed headers and children, output guards, 36/40/56-byte boundaries, 231 controlled fault pairs.
assumptions.falsification-probe: A repeated native leaf on another kernel contradicts the captured result.
assumptions.scope: One measured kernel; broader kernel equivalence remains unknown.

assumptions.assumption: Configured mapped and selected runtime roots are admitted namespace boundaries; their host aliases are outside guest OBJ_DONT_REPARSE component traversal.
assumptions.basis: DriveMap roots are host mapping configuration. Native DOS object aliases remain traversable under the measured OBJ_DONT_REPARSE profile.
assumptions.dependent-result: Canonical root selection with preserved guest leaf spelling.
assumptions.stress-test: Mapped-root alias remains usable; a guest leaf link is rejected under DONT_REPARSE; runtime aliases outside containment are denied.
assumptions.falsification-probe: A focused root/leaf test accepts the prohibited leaf traversal or rejects the admitted root alias.

assumptions.assumption: Legacy metadata-only HLE objects without a retained host File retain their existing pathname-identity limitation. Replacement survival is guaranteed only for the exercised retained-file path.
assumptions.basis: Existing files/open.rs leaves metadata-only host=None. FileIdentity fallback on Windows uses the canonical pathname. This group adds no broader open-object lifetime contract.
assumptions.dependent-result: Empty-name queries use a retained host file when present; future native file-open work must retain real handles.
assumptions.stress-test: Rename and replace a retained file pathname, then query the original object; keep the metadata-only limitation explicit.
assumptions.falsification-probe: The retained-file query observes replacement metadata, or the result is generalized to an unpinned object.
assumptions.scope: The retained-file test confirms its narrower guarantee; the legacy limitation remains.
